title: ClayGraph CG3 Resident Adaptive Escalation
summary: Cycle 3 imports hosted Groq 8B self-use showing current ClayGraph activation is not hot-path ready (~84-87ms runner retrieval vs SQLite FTS ~0.8-0.9ms, larger contexts, activation not consistently better than graph lexical) while preserving evidence that graph modes can surface relational facts FTS misses. A synthetic 10k-node implementation benchmark shows reload+scan 20.499ms median, resident scan 8.349ms and resident inverted seeding 0.106ms, motivating G1c: exact/packet/FTS baseline first, resident semantic index, adaptive graph escalation only for relation/scatter/uncertainty need, reranking and exact-anchor validation. Accepted ClayGraph remains G0; G1c is HOLD.
negative_results: current always-on activation hot path unsupported
activation not consistently better than graph lexical
synthetic resident speedup is not target latency
retrieval win does not authorize database merge
next_tests: stale assembly vs CognitiveFrame exact anchors
